description: The perp markets whose open interest (summed across the venues Angler reads) moved most over the last 24 hours, risers and fallers, plus the total change. Rising OI with a price move means new positions; falling OI means positions closing. Markets under $5M of open interest are left out.

limit.description: How many risers and fallers each (default 10).

name: get_oi_moves
title: Open interest moves
